title: Ghost Gobbler
description:
An affectionate tribute to the gold standard of arcade gaming, this pure JavaScript implementation of Pac-Man captures the exact tense grid-chasing mechanics of the 1980 classic. Players steer the round yellow hero through a glowing blue maze, gobbling up neon dots while four color-coded ghosts—Blinky, Pinky, Inky, and Clyde—stalk them with their distinct AI behaviors.

The developer did a brilliant job translating the tight responsiveness of original cabinet controls directly to modern arrow keys. It is a fantastic showcase of lightweight DOM manipulation and canvas rendering, proving you don't need a heavy engine to deliver a perfectly tuned, high-stress nostalgia trip.
howToPlay: Use the Arrow keys to navigate the maze. Eat all dots and avoid the ghosts. Grab power pellets to eat ghosts for bonus points.

title: Brick Stacker
description:
A clean, minimal canvas-based execution of the ultimate block-stacking puzzle. The game challenges you to rotate and align descending geometric pieces (tetrominoes) into solid horizontal lines, which instantly clear the board and boost your score. As the lines pile up, the speed increases, demanding quick spatial reasoning and rapid-fire decisions under pressure.

This particular open-source version stands out because of its absolute lack of bloat. It features zero clunky transitions or loud graphics, offering instead a sleek, responsive playing field that honors the timeless core loop. It is the perfect implementation for quick breaks and high-score chasing.
howToPlay: Move bricks with Left/Right Arrows, rotate with Up Arrow, and drop faster with Down Arrow. Form complete horizontal rows to clear them.

description:
The sliding tile puzzle that took the internet by storm, recreated here in all its mathematical, addictive glory. Players slide numbered tiles across a grid using the arrow keys, combining matching values to double their numbers (2, 4, 8, 16...) with the ultimate goal of reaching the elusive 2048 tile. Each slide spawns a new tile, slowly filling the grid and turning every move into a tactical choice to prevent a total gridlock.

What makes this puzzle so enduring is its deceptive simplicity. While the rules can be learned in seconds, surviving past the 512 tile requires a deliberate strategy of keeping your largest number tucked into a corner. It is a beautiful study in grid coordination and logical planning.
howToPlay: Use the Arrow keys to slide tiles. When two tiles of the same number collide, they merge into their sum. Try to reach the 2048 tile!

title: Hextris
description:
Hextris is a frantic, fast-paced puzzle game that takes the block-stacking formula of Tetris and wraps it around a rotating hexagon. Players rotate a central hexagonal column to catch incoming colored bars that slide in from the edges of the screen. Lining up three or more blocks of the same color on adjacent layers clears them, giving you a brief moment of breathing room before the next wave accelerates.

The game's vibrant neon aesthetics and energetic soundtrack create a high-tempo feedback loop that keeps you on edge. It requires rapid spatial scanning and quick hand-eye coordination as blocks begin to close in from all six sides simultaneously, making it one of the most intense puzzle games in our catalog.
howToPlay: Press Left/Right Arrows or mouse clicks to rotate the hexagon. Match three blocks of the same color in a row to clear them before they overflow the gray border.

title: Retro Racer
description:
Inspired by legendary arcade cabinets like OutRun and Pole Position, this pseudo-3D racer uses clever mathematical scaling of sprite layers to simulate high-speed movement down a winding road. Players must shift gears, accelerate, and weave through heavy traffic while cornering at breakneck speeds to beat the ticking checkpoint timer.

This JavaScript racing engine is a triumph of classic rendering techniques, built entirely on a 2D HTML5 canvas without WebGL. The result is a silky-smooth retro driving experience featuring elevation changes, curving horizons, and that unmistakable 80s arcade feel.
howToPlay: Use Left/Right Arrows to steer, Up Arrow to accelerate, and Down Arrow to brake. Avoid hitting roadside obstacles and other cars.

title: Floppy Wings
description:
A faithful recreation of the notorious mobile sensation that tested the patience of millions. Players tap the spacebar or click the screen to keep a little pixelated bird aloft, timing their flaps precisely to navigate through narrow gaps in a series of green pipes. A single collision with a pipe or the ground ends the run immediately, sending you back to zero.

It is a masterclass in minimal game design where a single control input yields maximum difficulty. The physics feel heavy and unforgiving, turning every high score of ten or more into a hard-earned badge of honor. It is the definition of "just one more try."
howToPlay: Click the screen or press Spacebar to flap your wings. Fly through the gaps in the green pipes without crashing.

title: Wash the Cat
description:
Wash the Cat is a humorous, chaotic arcade game where your only goal is to complete the impossible task of bathing a highly cooperative, but incredibly hyperactive feline. Players must navigate a cramped bathroom, dodging soap suds, splashing water, and claw strikes as they try to scrub the cat clean before time runs out.

The game is a fun showcase of quirky physics and goofy sprite animations that perfectly capture the struggle of cat ownership. Its lighthearted tone and simple mechanics make it an entertaining and chaotic casual experience.
howToPlay: Move your brush with the mouse or touch screen. Scrub the dirty cat clean before the timer runs out.

title: Underrun
description:
Created by Dominic Szablewski for the JS13K competition, Underrun is a technical masterpiece: a complete sci-fi twin-stick shooter packed into less than 13 kilobytes of code. Players explore a dark, atmospheric research facility overrun by alien lifeforms, using terminal hacking and heavy weapons to restore systems and escape.

The game features stunning WebGL graphics with dynamic lighting, glowing lasers, and fluid controls that rival full-scale commercial projects. Its tense, claustrophobic atmosphere and deep mechanical optimization make it an absolute must-play for fans of retro action.
howToPlay: Use WASD or Arrow keys to move your hacker clone, and Click to shoot incoming glitch enemies inside the computer systems.

title: Radius Raid
description:
Radius Raid is a fast-paced, space-themed shoot 'em up that drops you into the middle of a kinetic neon swarm. Players pilot an agile ship in a 360-degree arena, dodging enemy patterns while blasting incoming ships with a variety of upgradable weapons, all while maintaining their score multiplier.

Built for the JS13K jam, the game utilizes a custom particle system to fill the screen with bright, exploding fragments every time an enemy is destroyed. The resulting visual feedback loop is incredibly satisfying, delivering a pure arcade rush with tight keyboard responsiveness.
howToPlay: Aim and shoot with the mouse. Move your ship with WASD or Arrow keys to dodge incoming enemy space waves and collect power-ups.

title: Space Huggers
description:
Space Huggers is a retro-inspired, side-scrolling run-and-gun platformer that channels the classic action of games like Broforce and Metal Slug. Armed with a variety of heavy weapons, players drop into alien-infested levels to blast through destructible terrain, detonate explosive barrels, and eliminate hostiles.

The game's physics-based destructible environments and chunky pixel art create a playground of chaotic action. With tight jumping controls and responsive shooting mechanics, it offers a satisfyingly explosive combat experience.
howToPlay: Use WASD to run, jump, and climb. Aim and fire with the mouse. Free your fellow space marines and defeat the alien invaders.

title: Particle Clicker
description:
Particle Clicker is a highly polished incremental idle game themed around high-energy particle physics. Players start by clicking a particle detector to generate data, then hire researchers, purchase upgrades, and unlock advanced research papers to automate the process and earn massive amounts of funding.

The game combines educational concepts from real-world physics at CERN with the highly addictive feedback loops of the clicker genre. Its clean, modern interface and charts make it a fascinating and deeply satisfying strategy game.
howToPlay: Click the particle detector to generate research data and money. Buy upgrades and hire scientists to automate your particle accelerator.

title: Black Cat Squadron
description:
Black Cat Squadron is a retro-themed space shooter that simplifies aerial combat down to a single-button control scheme. Players steer a fighter jet as it automatically loops and arcs, timing their shots to shoot down incoming enemy fighters and capital ships in the skies.

The game's unique control mechanic turns what could be a standard shooter into a tactical rhythm game. Its stylized vector-style graphics and challenging waves make it a standout entry in the arcade category.
howToPlay: Steer your fighter jet with the mouse. Left-click to fire missiles at enemy squadrons and defend your base.

title: Catculus
description:
Catculus is a clever mathematical puzzle game featuring a charming cat companion. Players must click and combine numbered tiles and operational symbols (addition, subtraction, multiplication) to match a target number shown on screen before the grid fills up.

It is a great brain trainer that turns basic arithmetic into a fun, high-speed puzzle. The combination of cute animations and challenging level designs makes it an engaging puzzle game for players of all ages.
howToPlay: Solve basic math equations displayed on the screen. Select the correct answer quickly to feed the cat and earn high scores.

title: Ashes of Ulthar
description:
Drawing inspiration from the eerie tales of H.P. Lovecraft, Ashes of Ulthar is a dark, atmospheric resource management simulator. Players lead a remote village, assigning workers to collect resources, recruit defenders, and perform mysterious rituals to hold back the creeping madness of the old gods.

The game's monochrome pixel art style and unsettling ambient atmosphere perfectly capture the dread of cosmic horror. Every choice matters as you balance the physical survival of your town with the sanity of its inhabitants.
howToPlay: Command your units by clicking on them and clicking on target locations. Defend the sacred grounds from the invading cat army.

title: Feast Night
description:
Feast Night is a dark, top-down action game that places you in the middle of a creepy woodland clearing during a sinister ritual. Armed with only a lantern and your wits, you must navigate the shadows, collect fragments, and avoid the terrifying creatures hunting you in the dark.

The game uses HTML5 canvas techniques to render realistic shadows and dynamic line-of-sight lighting, creating a tense atmosphere where danger can lurk just outside your field of view. It is a haunting survival game that rewards patience and quick reactions.
howToPlay: Navigate the dark maze using the Arrow keys. Search for food while avoiding the monsters patrolling the corridors.

title: Six and Seven
description:
Six and Seven is a tactical rogue-lite dungeon crawler where players navigate a series of grid-based chambers filled with shadow demons. The core twist centers on the number 13: certain tiles and combat combinations trigger special mechanics, and opening the exit requires careful math and movement planning.

The developer created a compelling puzzle-combat loop where players must think several steps ahead to avoid getting cornered by demons. Its minimalist pixel graphics and clever tactical rules make each floor a rewarding puzzle to solve.
howToPlay: Deploy numbers on the grid. Group matching numbers together to trigger chains and clear space in this tactical puzzle game.

title: Clawstrike
description:
Clawstrike is a fast-paced 2D action platformer where you play as an agile cat seeking vengeance against waves of robotic invaders. Players must wall-jump, dash, and slash through mechanical enemies using tight, responsive movement controls in a series of compact arenas.

The game is a classic die-and-retry experience that demands precise timing and rapid reactions. Its fluid combat mechanics and retro arcade presentation make it a thrilling combat game.
howToPlay: Use WASD or Arrow keys to run and jump. Press Spacebar to strike enemies with your claws and protect the forest.

title: Battle Commander
description:
Battle Commander is a retro real-time strategy game set in the Middle Ages. Players must build barracks, train knights and archers, manage gold and food resources, and deploy their armies to capture enemy fortresses on a grid-based battlefield.

The game does an impressive job of bringing complex RTS mechanics like fog of war and unit counters into a lightweight browser format. It requires careful tactical positioning and economy management to outmaneuver the AI.
howToPlay: Click on your military barracks to deploy squads. Direct them to capture enemy territory and command strategic outposts.

title: Triskaideka
description:
Triskaideka is an intense retro-themed space shooter that pays homage to classic bullet-hell arcade cabinets. Players pilot a starship through asteroid fields and fleets of enemy battleships, dodging bullet patterns and deploying powerful shields to survive.

The game features sharp pixel art, explosive sound effects, and a pounding chiptune soundtrack that keeps the adrenaline flowing. Its high difficulty and satisfying ship progression make it a standout title for arcade fans.
howToPlay: Rotate the three-dimensional blocks to form complete shapes. Press Space to lock them in and clear rows before they hit the ceiling.

title: Thirteen Terrible Stunts
description:
Thirteen Terrible Stunts is a collection of 13 fast-paced microgames where players perform daring stunts like dodging oncoming trains, jumping over canyons, or balancing on tightropes. Each game lasts only a few seconds, forcing you to adapt to new rules instantly.

Drawing inspiration from the WarioWare series, the game is a chaotic and highly entertaining test of reflexes. Its quick transitions and quirky humor make it perfect for quick, fun gameplay sessions.
howToPlay: Accelerate with Up Arrow and tilt your vehicle using Left/Right Arrows. Perform mid-air stunts and land safely to score points.

title: Witchcat
description:
Witchcat is a whimsical puzzle platformer where you guide a witch's familiar—a black cat—through magical levels. The cat can jump, climb walls, and trigger magical switches to collect ingredients scattered across complex layouts.

The game stands out with its charming pixel-art design and clever puzzle mechanics. Players must use the cat's unique agility to bypass traps and solve environmental puzzles, making it a delightful adventure.
howToPlay: Guide the witch's cat using WASD or Arrow keys. Use magic spells with Spacebar to solve environmental puzzles and avoid curses.

title: Extreme Mini Massacre
description:
Extreme Mini Massacre is a high-intensity top-down arena shooter that pits you against endless waves of enemies. Armed with a rapid-fire laser rifle, you must circle-strafe, dodge projectiles, and collect weapon upgrades to survive as long as possible.

The game's simple, arcade-focused design is backed by incredibly tight controls and smooth movement physics. It delivers a pure, unadulterated action loop that is easy to pick up but difficult to master.
howToPlay: Move with Arrow keys and press Spacebar to swing your weapon. Clear out waves of small monsters in a fast-paced arena battle.

title: It's Raining Boxes?!
description:
It's Raining Boxes is a frantic arcade game where players must dodge a continuous downpour of crates falling from the sky. As crates stack up, they create platforms that you can climb, but getting crushed by a new block ends the game.

The game is a test of spatial awareness and quick positioning. The dynamic physics-based grid constantly shifts as boxes fall and bounce, making each run unpredictable and highly chaotic.
howToPlay: Move Left and Right with the Arrow keys. Catch falling boxes of your color while avoiding mismatched boxes and dangerous bombs.

title: Elematter
description:
Elematter is a deep, strategic tower defense game where players build defenses using the elements of fire, water, earth, and wind. Players must place towers strategically to exploit elemental weaknesses of incoming enemy waves.

The game features clean visual designs, satisfying tower upgrade paths, and a high level of tactical depth. Balancing resource collection with tower placement is key to defending your portal.
howToPlay: Click on elements to change their state (Fire, Water, Earth). Match adjacent elements to trigger energy reaction chains.

title: Lost
description:
Lost is an atmospheric sci-fi survival game that drops you into an uncharted sector of deep space. Players must navigate their ship through nebulas and asteroid fields, managing fuel and oxygen levels while fighting hostile alien ships.

The game's minimalistic visual style and haunting, solitary soundtrack create a powerful sense of isolation. It is a challenging space adventure that requires careful resource management and strategic exploration.
howToPlay: Use Arrow keys to explore the map. Interact with objects using Spacebar to find keys, unlock doors, and escape the labyrinth.

title: Neon Runner '84
description:
A gorgeous neon-styled WebGL endless runner set in a retro-futuristic landscape. Players control a ship gliding along a multi-lane grid, shifting lanes and jumping over hurdles to the beat of an electronic synthwave soundtrack.

The game's striking vector grid visuals and fluid animations capture the nostalgic vibe of 80s arcade classics. It is a hypnotic and visually stunning reaction game.
howToPlay: Press Spacebar or Click to jump over obstacles and avoid neon chasms in this fast-paced infinite runner.

title: Super Pinto Rally Racer
description:
Super Pinto is a classic rally racing game featuring retro pixel-art cars and drift-heavy physics. Players race against the clock on twisting dirt tracks, navigating hairpin turns and avoiding trackside hazards to set record times.

The game's simple arrow-key controls map perfectly to the drift mechanics, allowing for satisfying power-slides. It offers a nostalgic, high-speed racing experience.
howToPlay: Steer your rally car with Left/Right Arrows. Hold Up Arrow to drift around corners and finish the race before the timer hits zero.

title: Air Fury
description:
Air Fury is a 2D aerial dogfighting game that draws inspiration from the classic arcade game Luftrausers. Players pilot a customizable plane, performing loop-de-loops and aerial maneuvers to shoot down enemy aircraft, battleships, and blimps.

The game's arcade-style flight physics allow for incredible stunts and high-speed chases. Combined with its stylized, retro-color palette and satisfying explosions, it is a thrilling flight action game.
howToPlay: Fly your plane using the Arrow keys or WASD. Press Spacebar to fire your machine guns at enemy fighters and target battleships.

title: Evil Glitch
description:
Evil Glitch is an intense retro shooter where the game world itself is glitching. Players defend their base from corrupted pixel entities, using a variety of energy weapons while avoiding the breaking grid lines of the environment.

The game features a striking low-poly visual style and a chaotic glitch aesthetic. The combination of intense bullet-hell action and a collapsing digital arena makes it a uniquely challenging shooter.
howToPlay: Move your ship with WASD and shoot with the mouse. Repair broken dimensional gates before the corruption takes over the system.

title: Glitch Buster
description:
Glitch Buster is a puzzle-platformer where players act as a debugging program clearing glitches from a corrupted system. By running, jumping, and firing anti-glitch rays, you restore the system's files to their proper state.

The game combines tight platforming mechanics with clever level designs that utilize glitching elements (like disappearing platforms or inverted gravity). It is an entertaining and polished retro challenge.
howToPlay: Use Arrow keys to navigate the platform network. Fire anti-glitch lasers with Spacebar to clean infected memory blocks.

title: AMAZ3D
description:
AMAZ3D is a mind-bending 3D puzzle game where players rotate a wireframe cube to guide a colored orb through a complex maze. Connect metaballs and pipes to trigger portals and clear the path to the exit.

The game's minimalist WebGL aesthetics and relaxing ambient soundtrack make it a soothing, yet intellectually challenging puzzle experience. It is a brilliant showcase of 3D rendering in a tiny file size.
howToPlay: Navigate the 3D maze with WASD. Find the exit portal before the walls shift and trap you in the virtual labyrinth.

title: Mauja
description:
Mauja is a beautiful, atmospheric endless runner set in a snowy mountain range. Players jump over obstacles, slide under frozen arches, and gather coins while enjoying the peaceful, wintery scenery.

The game's minimalist graphics and smooth physics create a relaxing, flow-like gaming experience. It is the perfect casual game for unwinding and setting high scores.
howToPlay: Guide your avalanche using Left and Right Arrow keys. Grow larger by absorbing snow and debris while avoiding trees and warm cabins.

title: First Contact
description:
First Contact is a retro-styled space defense game where players protect a human colony from an incoming fleet of alien invaders. Deploy defense satellites, intercept enemy missiles, and fight boss ships.

The game features retro vector graphics and sound effects that channel 80s arcade cabinets. It requires strategic planning and quick firing to protect the planet's defenses.
howToPlay: Click on the terminal options to communicate with the alien entity. Make diplomatic choices to avoid initiating interstellar war.

title: Back to the Island
description:
Back to the Island is a survival adventure game set on a deserted island. Players must gather wood, catch fish, build shelters, and explore the mysterious jungle to find a way to escape.

The game's retro graphics and open-world survival mechanics offer a surprising amount of depth. It is a satisfying survival puzzle game that rewards curiosity and resourcefulness.
howToPlay: Explore the pixelated island using WASD. Collect materials, build shelters, and survive hostile native creatures.

title: Biscuit
description:
Biscuit is a quirky, fast-paced arcade game where players control a hungry dog seeking to eat as many biscuits as possible while dodging falling obstacles.

With simple controls and charming sprite animations, the game offers a fun and lighthearted casual experience. It is an easy-to-play, highly replayable score-chaser.
howToPlay: Help the puppy jump between floating cookies. Tap or Click at the right moment to perform a double jump and collect treats.

title: Highway 404
description:
Highway 404 is an endless retro driving game set on a digital highway. Players steer a futuristic vehicle through neon traffic, dodging firewall barriers and system glitches to keep driving.

The game's high-contrast visuals and rapid pace deliver a satisfying sense of speed. It is a great test of reflexes and lane-changing coordination.
howToPlay: Steer your cyber-bike with Left and Right Arrows. Shift lanes to dodge firewalls and virus barriers on the digital highway.

title: Space Bouncer
description:
Space Bouncer is a gravity-based physics game where players bounce an astronaut between orbiting gravity rings in deep space. Players click or tap to release the astronaut's tether, timing their leaps to avoid space debris and gather fuel.

The game features elegant orbital mechanics and simple, satisfying one-button gameplay. Timing your jumps to harness gravitational pull is challenging and deeply rewarding.
howToPlay: Tap or Click to bounce your astronaut between gravity rings. Avoid incoming space debris and maintain your orbit.

title: Tindeath
description:
Tindeath is a fast-paced arcade game that blends dating-app swiping mechanics with survival shooter gameplay. Players swipe left or right to match with or reject combat encounters, then fight off enemies in brief, chaotic arena battles.

It is a hilarious and creative parody of modern apps, backed by surprisingly deep combat mechanics. Its fast-paced, humor-filled loop makes it a highly entertaining casual experience.
howToPlay: Swipe Left or Right on target profiles. Accept missions or reject targets to manage your mercenary syndicate's reputation.

title: The Last Spartan
description:
The Last Spartan is a side-scrolling hack-and-slash action game where players fight off hordes of monsters as a legendary warrior. Armed with a spear and shield, players must block, counter, and strike down enemies.

The game's fluid combat animations and weight-based melee physics make every swing feel impactful. It is a satisfying and challenging combat platformer.
howToPlay: Fight off incoming hordes of invaders. Move with Arrow keys and strike with Spacebar to hold your ground at the pass.

title: Deep Space Voyager
description:
Deep Space Voyager is a top-down space exploration shooter. Players pilot a starship through asteroid fields, scanning planets for resources and upgrading their ship's engines and shields to survive.

The game features a vast, procedurally generated sector of space to explore, providing a sense of cosmic adventure. It is a compelling mix of survival, exploration, and space combat.
howToPlay: Pilot your spaceship using Arrow keys. Left-click to fire plasma bolts at meteors and enemy alien cruisers.

title: Norman the Necromancer
description:
Norman the Necromancer is a puzzle-action game where you control a wizard raising skeletons to defeat enemies. Players must command their undead minions to step on pressure plates, carry keys, and fight guards.

The game's clever puzzle designs and cute retro graphics make for an engaging tactical adventure. Balancing your mana pool with the number of active minions is key to solving each level.
howToPlay: Cast necromancer spells using the mouse. Raise skeleton warriors and direct them to attack incoming paladin legions.

title: Retro 3D Arena
description:
A technical marvel created for the JS13K competition, Retro 3D Arena (q1k3) is a fully playable 3D retro first-person shooter in less than 13 kilobytes of JavaScript. Inspired by classics like Quake, players navigate pixelated gothic halls, blasting demons with shotguns and rocket launchers.

The game features impressive 3D rendering, custom lighting, fluid movement physics, and responsive shooting mechanics. It is an incredible showcase of how much gameplay and atmosphere can be packed into a microscopic file size.
howToPlay: Move with WASD, jump with Spacebar, and aim/shoot with your mouse. Clear all enemy monsters in the level to open the escape portal.

title: Roll Tanks
description:
Roll Tanks is a physics-based tank battle game where players roll and fire shells at enemy tanks on destructible, hill-filled terrain. Movement is challenging as your tank rolls and bounces along the bumpy ground.

The game requires players to calculate shell trajectories and leverage gravity to strike enemies behind cover. Its fun physics and destructive combat make for an entertaining strategy shooter.
howToPlay: Move your rolling tank with WASD. Rotate the turret with the mouse and click to fire explosive rounds at enemy target blocks.

title: Sojuz 404
description:
Sojuz 404 is an atmospheric space action game featuring unique vector-style graphics. Players navigate a damaged space capsule back to Earth, dodging orbital debris and managing thrusters.

The game's minimalist line-art visuals and realistic physics create a tense, immersive experience. It is a challenging navigation game that requires precision and calm under pressure.
howToPlay: Pilot the Soyuz spacecraft through asteroid belts. Use Up/Down Arrows to adjust throttle and Left/Right to align docking ports.

title: Ninja
description:
Ninja is a fast-paced stealth action game where players navigate through shadow-filled levels. Players must dodge guards, disable security cameras, and strike from the shadows using swords and shurikens.

The game's fluid controls and emphasis on stealth make each level a rewarding tactical puzzle. Timing your movements to the guard patrols is essential to escaping undetected.
howToPlay: Run and wall-jump using WASD. Click the mouse to throw shurikens at guards and perform silent stealth takedowns.

title: Swagshot
description:
Swagshot is a stylized retro shooter with high-speed movement and trick-shot mechanics. Players dodge enemy lasers while firing bouncing bullets off walls to take down targets.

The game's neon color scheme and fast-paced electronic soundtrack create an energetic atmosphere. Bouncing shots off angles to hit hidden enemies is deeply satisfying.
howToPlay: Pull back, aim, and release the mouse to launch the ball. Bounce off walls to land trick shots into the goals.

title: Tenacity
description:
Tenacity is an arcade game that tests your speed and reflexes. Players must navigate a dot through a maze of moving obstacles, timing their movement to avoid collisions.

The game features minimalist visual designs and highly responsive controls. It is a challenging test of persistence and hand-eye coordination.
howToPlay: Tap or click the screen to flap and dodge obstacles. Time your jumps perfectly to keep running through the moving gears.

title: Two Ships Passing in the Night
description:
Two Ships Passing in the Night is a unique puzzle-action game where players control two ships simultaneously. One ship navigates a bright, visible field, while the other moves through darkness, requiring players to coordinate their movements.

The dual-control mechanic offers a challenging test of split-brain coordination. Its moody atmospheric graphics and clever level designs make it a standout puzzle game.
howToPlay: Control both ships simultaneously. Use WASD for the left ship and Arrow keys for the right ship. Dodge incoming hazards.

title: Callisto
description:
Callisto is a 3D space adventure set on Jupiter's icy moon. Players navigate a research rover across the frozen terrain, collecting mineral samples and avoiding geological hazards.

The game features impressive 3D WebGL graphics and a relaxing exploration loop. It is a satisfying sci-fi adventure game that rewards curiosity and exploration.
howToPlay: Navigate the frozen moon using WASD. Manage your oxygen levels and repair the satellite base station before freezing.

title: Minipunk
description:
Minipunk is a cyberpunk-themed arcade game featuring retro neon aesthetics. Players run along the streets of a neon city, dodging security drones and collecting data chips.

The game's atmospheric pixel art and synthwave track capture the classic cyberpunk vibe. It is a fast-paced casual game with simple, responsive controls.
howToPlay: Explore the neon cyberpunk streets. Hack terminal nodes by matching security keys within the time limit.

title: Stolen Sword
description:
Stolen Sword is an action-adventure platformer where players embark on a quest to recover their legendary weapon. Armed with only a shield initially, you must navigate traps, block attacks, and reclaim your sword.

The game features challenging platforming layouts, tight movement controls, and satisfying combat mechanics. Reclaiming your weapon changes the gameplay flow, adding a rewarding progression.
howToPlay: Use WASD to move and Spacebar to swing the sword. Defeat dungeon guards to retrieve your stolen weapon.

title: Cat Goric
description:
Cat Goric is a grid-based puzzle game where players guide a cat through a library, pushing books and blocks to create a path to the exit.

The game features cute retro graphics and increasingly complex puzzle designs. It requires careful planning to avoid trapping yourself, providing a satisfying workout for your brain.
howToPlay: Drag and drop the incoming blocks into categories. Match categories correctly to clear rows and keep the grid clean.

title: Death Game
description:
Death Game is a high-stakes arena action game where players fight for survival against waves of gladiators. Use swords, shields, and environmental traps to defeat your opponents.

The game features bloody retro pixel art and intense melee combat. Managing your stamina and positioning in the arena is key to surviving the final round.
howToPlay: Survive the gauntlet. Use WASD to dodge laser grids and time your dashes to avoid falling spikes.

title: Duszki
description:
Duszki is a charming ghost-themed arcade game. Players guide a friendly spirit through a series of haunted rooms, collecting glowing energy orbs while avoiding angry specters.

The game's cute animations, responsive controls, and lighthearted spooky atmosphere make it a delightful casual game for players of all ages.
howToPlay: Guide the friendly spirits using the mouse. Help them return to their portals while avoiding negative shadow entities.
